title: AlphaLogics Market-Logic-Driven Multi-Agent Alpha Mining on H198 Universe
description: Implement the AlphaLogics framework (Weng et al., arXiv:2603.20247, March 2026) for automated alpha factor discovery on the H198 30-stock large-cap universe. AlphaLogics is a three-component multi-agent system: (1) Market Logic Mining — reverse-engineer market logic from known factor libraries (H026, H045, H198 confirmed factors) to build a 'market logic library'; (2) Factor Generation & Optimization — use market logics to guide LLM-based factor code generation + backtest-feedback loop; (3) Market Logic Generation & Optimization — generate new market logics conditioned on the existing library, updated by factor backtest results. The key innovation vs. QuantaAlpha (H349): AlphaLogics adds the explicit 'market logic' abstraction layer (analogous to a hypothesis about why a factor should work), making discovery interpretable and the logic library reusable across regimes. Results on S&P500: significant improvement in predictive metrics and risk-adjusted returns over representative baselines. Gate: OOS Sharpe > 1.174 (H198 baseline). IS: 2013-2020, OOS: 2021-2026. Cost: ~$15-40 OpenAI API for factor generation loop. Script: backtesting/daily/run_h381_alphalogics.py (to be written).
rationale: AlphaLogics is explicitly validated on the S&P500 (same universe family as H198), making it a direct test candidate. The 'market logic' abstraction is philosophically aligned with our hypothesis-driven research process — the system generates hypotheses about why factors should work, then tests them. The multi-agent coordination (mining agent, generation agent, optimization agent) mirrors H274's PEAD debate architecture and H318's meta-learner design. Compared to QuantaAlpha (H349, evolutionary without explicit logic) and FactorEngine (H382/2603.16365, program-level), AlphaLogics adds the interpretable logic layer that lets us audit whether discovered factors make economic sense. OpenAI API key is available.
